messages: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
#p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p202##k, the leader of this town. I'm a little nervous about meeting the Chief!\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I greeted #p202#, the town representative of #m10001000#. He seems a bit strict, but he definitely feels like someone I can rely on.
name: First Greeting with Chief Stan
